answer_1.quote: Video large language models (Vid-LLMs) integrate video inputs with textual instructions and demonstrate strong performance across a wide range of video-language tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates answers to video-based questions, both in multiple-choice and open-ended formats.

answer_2.quote: Response quality is assessed using GPT-based metrics: GPT-Accuracy for factual correctness, and GPT-Score (0-5) for completeness and fluency.
